name: sre-onsite-bangalore
jobText:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer — Bangalore (Onsite)

Join our infrastructure team as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer based out of our Bangalore office. This is a full-time onsite role.

What you'll do:
- Own production reliability for our core services running on AWS
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins
- Operate Kubernetes clusters and Docker-based deployments
- Automate infrastructure provisioning with Ansible

What we're looking for:
- 10+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering
- Deep experience with AWS
- Strong Kubernetes and Docker experience
- Experience with Ansible for configuration management

You will be part of an on-call rotation covering production incidents.

This is a hands-on engineering ownership role — you'll drive the reliability roadmap for your services, not just respond to tickets.
